title: Function Adgroupchanges
author: reprise99
description: Save as a function in your workspace then invoke via its name, i.e if you save as ADGroupChanges ADGroupChanges | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d) | where Action == "Add" and GroupName == "TestGroup1" // will all group additions to "TestGroup1" ADGroupChanges | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d) | where Action == "Remove" and Actor == "User1" // will find all group removals by "User1" This will parse the SecurityEvent log for any group additions or removals.
